integrity: A symbolic proof establishes the infinite classification. Finite exhaustive tests are auxiliary, not an infinite certificate. Publication priority has not been independently confirmed.
limitations: Bases at least four, lengths at least two, and nonzero final digit only. Prime consequence concerns only the 2q-reversal subclass; no infinitude of special-form prime pairs proved.
title: Exact base-and-length rigidity for reversal equal to twice the integer minus four
